item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains, Ignite releases
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains adds remote access, on-device voice dictation, browser use controls, and context usage shortcuts. The update also includes historical diffs and other simplifications for JetBrains IDE users.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 2
item.description:
GitHub Copilot added support for JetBrains Air and Xcode’s coding assistant, and shipped updates for managing pull requests, settings, and agent sessions. The post also mentions an agent merge setup update in the GitHub Copilot app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now lets users control the default model and MCP server, and includes updates that make diagnostics easier to resolve. The release also improves chat navigation and account controls.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — September 21
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s weekly release roundup adds new models, local sandboxing in the Copilot app, and updates across Copilot integrations in Slack, Microsoft Teams, JetBrains, and VS Code.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New features and improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.18.0 adds AI-assisted tool approvals, more control over agent conversations, and organization-wide shared skills and instructions. It also includes plan review support with Codex.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise-managed sandbox in Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise-managed sandbox policies, along with cross-file cursor jumps for next edit suggestions, global project context in chat, and enterprise policy diagnostics. The update also adds a new terminal Copilot connection.

  • Source: GitHub
